steps.en: Install the whole collection with the skills CLI
steps.zh: 用 skills CLI 一次装齐整套集合

steps.en: Each skill becomes a SKILL.md folder in your agent's skills directory, waiting to be pulled
steps.zh: 每个 skill 落成 SKILL.md 文件夹，等待按需触发

steps.en: Build and test in Vue / Nuxt / Vite as usual
steps.zh: 照常写 Vue/Nuxt/Vite 的代码和测试

steps.en: The agent pulls the matching skill into context only when a task triggers it
steps.zh: 任务匹配时，agent 才把对应 skill 拉进上下文

steps.en: Generated skills answer from official docs kept fresh as git submodules under sources/
steps.zh: 生成类 skill 依据 sources/ 子模块同步的官方文档作答

value.en: The agent writes the stack the way its own maintainers do — his conventions plus doc-accurate framework usage, without you authoring rules per tool
value.zh: agent 按生态维护者本人的约定与官方文档口径写代码，不必你逐工具立规矩
